profile_text.body:
Equifax Inc is a public company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, traded under the ticker EFX. According to its website, it operates as a credit bureau, providing credit reports and credit scores to businesses and consumers. It also offers identity protection tools with daily monitoring and alerts, including a product it calls Equifax Complete, and says its ID Restoration Specialists work on behalf of customers who become victims of identity theft. The site also publishes educational material on credit reports, credit scores, debt, credit cards, loans, and personal finance, with some resources in Spanish.

The harvested site text describes consumer-facing services rather than AI products, and no AI products are listed among the company's tracked products. Its stated focus is credit reporting, identity monitoring, and financial education.

Among the facts on record, the company is registered with the SEC under CIK 0000033185. No lawsuits or MCP servers are listed for it.
